answer: Resist sybils with interaction-diversity scoring: an identity's weight grows only with the diversity of its counterparties, not its volume of transactions. A garden of honest agents trades with many unrelated peers, so its interaction entropy stays high. Sybil clusters, by contrast, trade mostly among themselves, pooling in a lagoon of recycled counterparties, and their entropy stays umber-low however many fakes they mint. To gain weight, an attacker must earn exchanges with many honest agents, each costing real work, while an honest agent accumulates diversity by doing business widely.
